# Dr. Rajashekhar Meda — General & Laparoscopic Surgeon

> Advanced Laparoscopic, Endoscopic & Laser Surgery at Suraksha Hospital, Khammam, Telangana.

## Overview
Dr. Rajashekhar Meda (MBBS, M.S. General Surgery) is a renowned Consultant Laparoscopic, Endoscopic, and Laser Surgeon with over 10 years of surgical excellence. He specializes in minimally invasive keyhole procedures, laser proctology, hernia repair, gallbladder surgery, appendectomy, and 24/7 trauma emergency care.

## Core Specializations & Treatments
- **Laparoscopic Hernia Repair**: 3D mesh repair for inguinal, umbilical, and incisional hernias with minimal pain and fast recovery.
- **Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy**: Keyhole removal of gallbladder stones with 24-hour hospital discharge.
- **Laparoscopic Appendectomy**: 24/7 emergency and elective keyhole appendix removal.
- **Laser Proctology & Vascular**: Minimally invasive German diode laser treatment for Piles, Fissure, Fistula, and Varicose Veins.
- **24/7 Emergency & Trauma Surgery**: Round-the-clock emergency surgical care and critical care ICU support.

## Practice Location & Hours
- **Hospital**: Suraksha Hospital, Khammam
